[6:21PM] #Idumota #TrafficUpdate 

Good traffic movement from the 3rd Mainland Bridge, inward Adeniji Adele Road, through Oba's Palace and Police Post.
Slow movement from Idumota underneath the bridge, inward Eyin Eyo, connecting Balogun Street, attributed to market activities in the area.
Busy traffic conditions from Tinubu Square, connecting Carter Bridge via Tom Jones Intersection, due to the evening return journey rush.
Expected traffic movement on Ilubinrin, ascending Carter Bridge, inward Ijora Olopa, as well as Oyingbo.

#FollowLASTMA

Faster traffic movement from Zone 2 underneath the bridge towards Flagstaff House, connecting McWen Bridge.

Perfect traffic movement from Onikan Roundabout towards TBS, inward Water Board, connecting Nitel Intersection.

Smooth traffic flow on the entire stretch of Broad Street, from General Hospital towards Tinubu Square, connecting Abibu Oki Street and Martins Junction.

Slow movement approaching Balogun Junction, inward journey from Apongbon.

Perfect traffic movement on the entire stretch of Igbosere Road.

Good traffic movement from Catholic Mission Street, connecting Ganiu Smith Street.
